data.creator_notes:
He is very hungry!

If you know what this is then there isn't much left to explain. If you don't know what this is... he is from an old set of flash games called 'Pumkin Land' and his specific game involved needing to be fed various types of foods, based on what he requests. Eventually reached meme status (definitely go look up vids and fanmade content if you've never seen before, funny stuff).

##Known Issue For Greeting #2:
Anyway I wanted to have his greeting be randomized for different types of starting requests and, while it does work, I notice sometimes it glitches out and displays all the random text rather than just one chosen output; if you encounter this issue, all you need to do is edit the message and then immediately click accept and it'll properly choose a random word.
